tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: lha sman rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i gsol mchod bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so:

bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: ā+oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs/ a kā ro sogs/ lha sman g.yu sgron sku mdog dkar: sha ba yu mo la 'chib nas: ne'u gsing nang nas me tog 'thu: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon me long: bshud glu kyur kyur dga' ba'i tshul: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: spyan 'dren mchod pa'i lha mo ni: rdo rje g.yu sgron dam tshig can: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: yi ge hrīḥlas skur sprul ma: spyan ras gzigs sogs lcam gcig ma: chos mdzad yongs kyi yum gcig mo: de ring ming pos 'bod lags kyis: spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: rdo rje 'chang gis gnyer gtad nas: gsang sngags srung ma mdzad pa'i phyir: pad 'od o rgyan tsa ri tra: gnas chen rnams nas gshegs su gsol: dbang phyug shākya seng ge yis: dam chos rgyas par bka' bsgos bzhin: 'phags yul gangs can ljongs rnams kyi: chos 'khor rnams nas gshegs su gsol: khyad par tsha ba khe shod yul: brag nag gangs ri'i cod pan can: chu klung nags ma me tog mdzes: shel gur dbus nas gshegs su gsol: rdo rje g.yu sgron dam tshig can: thugs rjes gnas 'dir byon pa legs: rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng du: ci bder bzhugs la 'dod don stsol: ā+oṃ badz+ra ma ma la la li li sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: yum gcig rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: 'khor bcas dgyes byed mchod pa ni: yan lag brgyad ldan 'o ma'i mtsho: gtsang ma dri zhim mchod pa 'bul: ut+pa la dang ku mu da: puṇ+ṭa la sogs me tog rigs: gtsang ma dri zhim mchod pa 'bul: a ga ru dang du ruṣ+ka: ga pur tsan+dan la sogs pa: gtsang ma dri zhim mchod pa 'bul: rnga chen dung dang rol mo'i tshogs: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sgra snyan rnams: rdo rje g.yu sgron khyod la 'bul:

mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra: tsan+dan dri dang ro brgya'i zas: lha rdzas na bza' la sogs kun: rdo rje g.yu sgron khyod la 'bul: gser dngul la sogs rin chen dang: ka ra bu ram bcud kyi mchog: ga pur la sogs sman sna rnams: rdo rje g.yu sgron khyod la 'bul: dam rdzas mchod gtor ri ltar spungs: zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: rten rdzas spyan gzig gcal du bkram: dngos bshams yid sprul 'di phul mthus: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings: dge 'dun sde rgyas 'byor par ldan: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod don sgrubs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang: 'khor dang longs spyod dbang du sdus: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig: chos dang longs spyod 'byor par ldan: gnas 'dir bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: 'gro don phyogs med khyab par mdzod: khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi: legs nyes spyod tshul gsal bar ston: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin sogs: ci ltar smon pa'i dngos grub stsol: gsal byed pra yi sgo phyes la: longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol: mdor na phrin las gang bcol ba: thogs pa med par lung bstan zhing: g.yel ba med par sgrub pa sogs: dngos grub 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hring hring dzaḥdza: sa pa ri wā ra ma hā bha liṃ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: ā+oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ badz+ra rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe ra sa spar+she sarba pū dza pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: chos sku'i dbyings la spros pa mi mnga' yang: longs sku rigs lnga ma dang mkha' 'gror ston: sprul sku'i sman mos 'gro don mdzad la bstod: sprul sku gnas la nges pa ma mchis kyang: ri rab grong dang nags tshal mtsho gling dang: lho mon bod dang rgya gar la sogs kyi:

yul rnams kun tu dngos grub ster la bstod: chos mdzad srung ma spyan ras gzigs kyi lcam: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dngos grub kun gyi bdag: dam tshig can la dgos 'dod 'bras stsol ma: rdo rje g.yu sgron 'khor dang bcas la bstod: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi gtso mo ste: mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang mo khyod kho na: 'jig rten dbang phyug mi bskyod rdo rje yi: lcam gcig rdo rje g.yu sgron gang de bstod: sngon gyi bskal pa'i thog mar khyod nyid kyang: sha wa ri dang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: mi bskyod bzang po rdo rje dga' ba sogs: rig 'dzin yongs kyi lcam gcig khyod la 'dud: ji ltar khas blangs bzhin du 'gro rnams la: thugs rje can gyis nyin mtshan rgyun du gzigs: ma bzhin brtse bas skyong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: g.yo med kun tu ston la gus phyag 'tshal: gzhan la dbang sgyur 'khor lo rin chen 'dra: dgos 'dod 'byung ba yid bzhin nor bu 'dra: mi 'bral gzugs mchog btsun mo rin chen 'dra: yon tan kun stsol blon po rin chen 'dra: theg pa'i don rtogs glang po rin chen 'dra: sa bcu bgrod mdzad rta mchog rin chen 'dra: phas rgol 'joms mdzad dmag dpon rin chen 'dra: dbang po brgya byin ltar ni longs spyod che: me tog pad+ma ltar ni sku mdangs legs: u dumawa ra ltar ni skye ba dkon: nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar ni kha dog legs: phyag na rdo rje ltar ni mthu rtsal che: 'jig rten mgon po ltar ni kun gyis bstod: thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang: dus rnams kun tu lha mo khyod la bstod: de nas gsol kha byed na slar gso bran dang a kā ro brjod na rung: hūm̐: rdo rje brtan ma g.yu sgron ma: sku mdog kun+da ltar dkar zhing: bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can: khyad par 'phags pa'i lha mo ni: zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul can: spyan gnyis sgrub pa po la gzigs: g.yu yi smin ma dung gi tshems:

phyag g.yas mda' dar nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas dngul dkar me long 'dzin: sman sha yu mo chibs su 'chib: lha rdzas na bza' dgu brtsegs gsol: rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan: khyod kyi na bza'i sul rnams nas: rin chen sna tshogs char du 'beb: sgrub mchog 'dod pa'i re ba skong: mkha' 'gro dkar mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon gtsang ma'i phud la rol: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol: sngon tshe pad+mas bka' bsgos bzhin: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rigs bzhi'i sman btsun mched bzhi ni: sngo ser dmar dang ljang ba'i mdog: drel rta rkyang dang 'brong la 'chib: rang rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan 'dzin: rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'dir byon gtsang ma'i phud la rol: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: sngon tshe pad+mas bka' bsgos bzhin: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rdo rje brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs ldan: so so'i zhon pa sna tshogs 'chib: rigs dang mthun pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: phyi 'khor sman mo 'bum phrag dang: ma lus 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas: lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'dir byon gtsang ma'i phud la rol: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: so so'i dngos grub thams cad stsol: rdo rje g.yu sgron 'khor bcas la: snga ma las byas gtang rag gtong: phyi ma las bcol zhu skyems 'bul: da lta las kyi gnyer zas 'di: dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol: rdo rje 'chang dbang he ru ka:

ston pa gsang bdag rta mgrin dang: mkha' 'gro seng gdong pad+ma 'byung: bzhad pa rdo rje karma pa: sangs rgyas dbon po gar gyi dbang: sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar: ma ltar bsten no dbang ma che: sring ltar bsten no snying ma ring: mdza' ltar bsten no gzhung ma ngan: bran ltar bsten no zhe ma sdang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: bdag gi brgyud pa'i bstan pa srungs: bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe srings: lung rtogs chos srid 'dzin pa yi: dge 'dun sde rnams skyong bar mdzod: mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: snang srid thams cad dbang du sdus: bstan dang bdag cag dpon slob la: sdang ba'i dgra bo thams cad thul: byin pa'i zas 'di khyod kyis gsol: bcol pa'i las rnams thams cad sgrubs: ji ltar gdams pa'i ngag la nyon: bdag gi dgos pa'i don rnams sgrubs: ma rung gdug pa'i dgra 'di sod: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams thul: bar chad rkyen rnams thams cad zlog: sdod pa'i gnas mal khyod kyis srungs: nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad spel: brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i las rnams sgrubs: 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar: rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs nas kyang: ji ltar 'dod pa'i re ba kun: 'bad pa med par 'grub par mdzod: de nas skong ba byed na gnam chos nas 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ hrī: sring cig rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i: thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang: dam tshig nyams pa thams cad bshags: gang bcol las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri dang zhal zas dang: rol mo sgra dbyangs thams cad kyis: g.yu sgron 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun: bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kyis: g.yu sgron 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: g.yag lug ra gsum lha 'bri dang: dkor nor ri dwags g.yung dwags sogs:

mthun rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis: g.yu sgron 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: bdag cag bag med dbang gyur nas: sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba yi: nyams pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags: bzod par bzhes nas dgyes par mdzod: khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chod sol: pha rol byad dang rbod gtong dang: skag dang sri dang ltas ngan dang: rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa sogs: mi mthun phyogs rnams thams cad zlog: bdag dang bdag la sdang ba yi: dam nyams sdig can dgra bgegs 'di: lo zla zhag tu ma bzhag par: da lta nyid du myur du sgrol: khyod ni srung ma thugs dam can: bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can: khyed dang dam tshig gcig pa'i phyir: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ hrī: steng phyogs dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas na: rin chen sprin dkar brtsegs pa'i gur khang nas: rdo rje g.yu sgron sman btsun 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: dam rdzas gtsang ma bsham pa'i mchod pa 'di: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la mchod par 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs sbyin pa'i mchod pa bzhes: mchod pa bzhes shig a la la ho: ā+oṃ badz+ra ma ma la la li li sarba pañtsa a mṛta pū dza khā hi: zhes phud gtor na yang rung ba'o// 'di yi sgrub thabs klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad par bdag bskyed du mdzad par bshad/ dbang phyug rdo rjes 'di kho na ltar mdzad nas/ bdag bskyed spyan ras gzigs su nges par bskyed/ ma ṇi bsgrang ba sogs mdzad/ yang na gu ru bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med gsungs/ kar lugs sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ dza: zhes dang*/ ā+oṃ bhi lug k+ṣa na a lo k+ṣa kha ya swā hā: zhes bsnyen sngags so// ā+oṃ bhi li bhi li khyi li khyi li a lo k+ṣa kha ya swā hā:

zhes sgrub sngags rgyun du byed na de gas chog /las sbyor pra sgrub sngags ni gzhung du gsal/ mkhas grub lung rig nyi mas/ mtshan sngags ni/ ā+oṃ āḥbadz+ra shā sa na ma hā bā la bhi ro tsa nā dī pe swā hā: 'di mdzad/ klong chen rab 'byams pa'i rin chen shog 'dra las/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ swā hā: gnam chos las/ oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha ba su sid+dhi hriṃ dzaḥhūm̐ swā hā: 'brug lugs sngags ni/ oṃ ma ma la la li li: zhes gsungs so// zhi sgrub 'di kar 'brug lugs klong chen rab 'byams pa gnam chos mthun par thugs srog hrīḥyig la/ lung rig nyi mas ming yig dang po ste dkar po yin gsungs so// de ltar gtor chog 'di ni gnam chos las byung ba dang*/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje dang*/ mthu chen rdo rje 'dzin pa/ klong chen rab 'byams dang*/ lung rig nyi ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i khungs btsun la brten te/ rat+na lugs dang nyang lugs pad gling sogs dang mi 'gal bar/ sngags 'chang rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa nyes 'gal mchis na lha mo nyid la bshags shing*/ dge bas bdag gi brgyud pa nges par 'dzin pa rnams la phrin las thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
